title: Starr 6oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco
description:
Starr 6oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco

Starr 6oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco is a classic loose leaf-style chewing tobacco product. Loose leaf chewing tobacco is the most common type of chewing tobacco. It simply consists of shredded tobacco leaves. Starr 6ozs Loose Leaf Chewing has a traditional tobacco flavor and is manufactured by Swisher International. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compared to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experienced in plug and long cut. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Starr brand page.
